_about: Conditions on a line (PLANNING-BRIEF 0.7; D13): each is a change to the line's Setup, applied by content before the world is built; sim does not know which mission it is running. Fields (Sam, 2026-10-05) are placed relative to a spout: plates fill a box from `x0` to `x1` cm either side of the spout's nozzle and from `from_rim` cm above the cups' rim to `below_spout` cm under the nozzle, pushing by `accel` thousandths of a cm per tick² (and reversing every `flip` ticks if given); a charge sits `dx`, `dy` cm from the nozzle with `strength` thousandths of a cm per tick² at its center (negative pulls) fading to nothing at `radius` cm. A held condition is designed and not yet built.
